title: Hadeon attends VivaTech 2026
summary: Nikos represented Hadeon at VivaTech in Paris, one of Europe's largest technology and innovation events.

title: Core technology accepted to ICRA 2026
summary: Hadeon's trajectory-optimization research was accepted and presented at ICRA 2026, one of robotics' most prestigious academic venues.

title: Hadeon attends SaaS North 2025
summary: Nikos represented Hadeon at SaaS North as part of the Startup Atlantic cohort, connecting with founders and investors across the Canadian tech ecosystem.

title: Hadeon secures $195,000 in Mitacs R&D funding
summary: Mitacs Accelerate and Business Strategy Internship grants fund the buildout of Hadeon's core development team.

title: Hadeon forms R&D partnership with Dynamium Lab
summary: The partnership gives Hadeon access to advanced test facilities and a pipeline of Atlantic Canadian robotics talent.

title: Hadeon Robotics is founded
summary: Incorporated and selected for the Venn Innovation Garage, Hadeon begins building a no-code motion-planning engine.
